mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real GDP signals a weakening economy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals labor market weakness, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the negative economic signal.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in industrial production signals a strengthening economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised upwards.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts signals increased demand for housing and related goods, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic activity and corporate earnings expectations improve.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and CPI inflation rises by more than 0.5% in a month, the combination signals inflationary pressure and tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 300,000 and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.3% in the same month, the combination signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased consumer spending.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 300,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real final sales signals increased consumer spending, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised upwards.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
